questions.subject: Science
questions.question: What gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb CO2 and release O2 as a byproduct!
questions.funFact: A single tree produces oxygen for 4 people daily!

questions.subject: Science
questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum' meaning gold
questions.funFact: All gold ever mined would fill only 3 Olympic pools!

questions.subject: History
questions.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.explanation: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa in the early 1500s
questions.funFact: The Mona Lisa has her own mailbox in the Louvre!
